items.title: Ernest "Punch" Miller Interview, 1971-04-08
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Why don't you write a song called Cock Robin? That'll make a good song, wouldn't it, Paul?

ctx.x: Well, no, I haven't sung it this time. I just think I'm getting out of here.
Why don't you write a song called Cock Robin? That'll make a good song, wouldn't it, Paul? Oh, yeah. He has. I like that number. Yeah.
How do the words to that work?
